verdict.rationale: Warp says it offers an API alongside its CLI, SDK and MCP (warp-docs-42), and a probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on the docs site (warp-docs-openapi probe), which is the usual basis for a generated API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples; the 'api--reference' docs content covers Oz CLI topics like API keys and agent profiles. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it request examples, documented API endpoint reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
